claim_scope: conditional competition score against a participant-built independent benchmark; not official accuracy and not measured wear truth
limitations: The reference field is participant-built and synthetic/prior-based.
The combination score is independent by leave-one-model-out and leave-one-seed-out construction, but it is not measured physical accuracy.
Official accuracy, official reference, and formal FEM gates remain closed.
